<h1 id="mermaid" data-source-start="1" data-source-end="1">Mermaid</h1>
<pre class="mermaid" data-source-start="3" data-source-end="8">graph TD;
    A[Старт] --&gt; B{Условие};
    B --&gt;|да| C[Готово];
    B --&gt;|нет| A;
</pre>
